subject: gk
question: Sangeet Natak Akademi is a society under which ministry of the Government of India?

options.text: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Ministry of Culture**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi** is the national level academy for performing arts in **India**.
 
• It was set up by the **Government of India** in **1952**.
 
• The **Ministry of Culture** is responsible for the preservation and promotion of art and culture in India.
 
• The **Ministry of Culture** oversees various cultural institutions, including the **Sangeet Natak Akademi**.
 
• The **Sangeet Natak Akademi** works to promote and preserve the vast cultural heritage of India in the field of performing arts, including dance, drama, and music.
 
• The **Sangeet Natak Akademi** provides recognition and financial support to artists and scholars in the field of performing arts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Home Affairs**__

 __
 
• The **Ministry of Home Affairs** is responsible for internal security, border management, and domestic policy.
 
• It also oversees the functioning of the police, paramilitary forces, and disaster management in India.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Tourism**__
 __
 
• The **Ministry of Tourism** is responsible for the development and promotion of tourism in India.
 
• It aims to increase tourist arrivals and boost the country's tourism industry through various initiatives and schemes.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**__
 
 
• The **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** focuses on the development of youth and sports activities in India.
 
• It implements programs and policies to encourage youth participation in sports and physical activities.
